title: Article 344 — Commission and Committee of Parliament on official language

content.overview: Article 344 provides for a Commission on official language to be constituted by the President at the expiration of five years from commencement and thereafter at the expiration of ten years from commencement (and as Parliament may provide). The Commission makes recommendations on progressive use of Hindi, restrictions on English, language of the Supreme Court and High Courts and Acts, and related matters. A Parliamentary Committee examines the recommendations and reports to the President.
content.glance: President constitutes Official Language Commission (after 5 and 10 years, etc.); recommendations on Hindi/English use. Parliamentary Committee examines and reports to President.
content.study:
Article 344 institutional machinery:
- Official Language Commission appointed by the President at specified intervals.
- Duty to make recommendations on progressive use of Hindi for Union official purposes, restrictions on English, form of numerals, language of SC/HC/Acts, and related matters.
- Parliamentary Committee of 30 members (20 LS + 10 RS) examines recommendations and reports to the President.
- President may issue directions in accordance with the whole or part of the report.

Examination: Commission + Committee; progressive use of Hindi; directions by President.

sections.heading: Machinery
sections.body:
1. Official Language Commission appointed by President at constitutional intervals.
2. Recommendations on Hindi use, English restrictions, SC/HC/Acts language, etc.
3. Parliamentary Committee examines recommendations; reports to President.
4. President may issue directions accordingly.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What does Article 344 provide?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 344 provides for the constitution by the President of a Commission on official language at the expiration of five years from the commencement of the Constitution and thereafter at the expiration of ten years from such commencement (and as further provided). The Commission recommends on the progressive use of Hindi, restrictions on the use of English, the language of the Supreme Court and High Courts and of Acts, and related matters. A Committee of Parliament examines the recommendations and reports to the President, who may issue directions in accordance with the report.

examTips: Official Language Commission + Parliamentary Committee; progressive Hindi use.

keyTakeaways: Art 344: Official Language Commission and Parliamentary Committee.
